intro: Lesson 26: Fasting and its purpose. Plan or write in each box.

parts.text: Point 1: fasting is private worship. Develop: no one sees if you secretly drink, so you learn Allah watches: taqwa (2:183). Point 2: it trains the tongue. Develop: the hadith on false speech (Bukhari).
